Daily Devotional

November 11

6 For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. 7 But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another. (Psalms 75:6-7 KJV)

It is interesting that this verse does not list the north. Does this mean that God lives in the North? I believe it must mean that as the north is up on the maps of the earth that God is up in heaven above the earth, so God is up north. This is telling us that promotion does not come from people, but from God. Since God gives promotion, then we should not try to gain it by carnal means, but if we will serve, at whatever we do, as if we were serving God, then He will see that we get our promotions (Colossians 3:23-24). It is all about putting God first in everything we do, and if we will do that, then He will provide for all our needs, and promote us to the fullness. Most believers do not follow this advice, as it goes against what the world tells us. It is hard for us humans to think this way, but it is very true, as a godly person has the characteristics that will get him promoted.

It is always God who puts one up, and another down, as He judges what we are doing. In the Kingdom of God, up is down, and down is up, as if you try to gain things by worldly means (up), then God will humble you in some way, but if you will humble yourself, and put God and others above yourself, then God will exalt you (Matthew 23:12). It is all about doing the commandments of Jesus, as loving God above all, and loving your neighbors as yourself (Matthew 22:37-40). Our generation is a “me” generation, as it is all about self, and that is against the teaching of Jesus. Humble yourself, and always put others first and you will reap the blessings of God (James 4:10). For a person to put others above himself, requires you to let Christ live through you (Galatians 2:20), as you can’t do it on your own. Only by letting the Spirit of Christ live through you, can you be a “Little Christ”, as it goes against human nature. Thank you Jesus for living in and through me!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
